user.title: ESP-NOW 2 MQTT
user.description: Connect to the USB coordinator bridge over MQTT. Install the ESP-NOW 2 MQTT add-on (or run the bridge) first. Devices appear automatically — no YAML. Add one entry per coordinator, each with its own base topic.

data_description.base_topic: Must match the bridge's --base-topic. Use a different topic for each coordinator.

abort.already_configured: A coordinator is already configured on this base topic
abort.mqtt_not_ready: MQTT integration is not set up. Add MQTT first.

init.title: ESP-NOW 2 MQTT options
init.description: Changing the base topic reloads the integration. Entities keep their history, but they stay unavailable until a bridge publishes on the new topic.

error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this base topic

permit_join.name: Permit join
permit_join.description: Open the mesh for new devices to pair. Applies to every configured coordinator.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long pairing stays open, in seconds (1–300).
